Package com.saicone.gama.util

Class Dual<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.gama.util.Dual<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the object type at left position.
B - the object type at right position.
public class Dual<A,B> extends Object
An object with the same functionality of a Pair object with mutable contents.
This class provides utility methods to interact with its content.

    • valueOf

      @NotNull public static <T> @NotNull Dual<T,T> valueOf(@Nullable T[] array)
      Creates a new dual object from the given array.
      • If the array is null or empty, an empty dual object is returned.
      • If the array has one element, a dual object with the first element and null is returned.
      • If the array has two or more elements, a dual object with the first two elements is returned.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the object type at both positions.
      Parameters:
      array - the array to create the dual object from.
      Returns:
      a newly generated dual object.

    • valueOf

      Parameters:
